newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil lower house has quorum to vote re-election.
newsitem.headline: Brazil lower house has quorum to vote re-election.

text.p: The Brazilian Chamber of Deputies has the quorum it needs to start voting on a bill allowing presidential re-election, a Congress official said.
The official said 428 out of a total of 513 deputies had registered their presence in the house.

The government intends to put a constitutional amendment allowing re-election to a first round vote later Tuesday. The session was due to start at around 1600 local/1800 GMT with balloting expected to take place some three hours later.
The bill must pass through two rounds of voting in both the lower and upper houses, needing a majority of 60 percent each time.
